mapper.select: SELECT soi.id, soi.purchase_order_id, po.order_no AS purchase_order_no, soi.purchase_order_item_id, soi.sku_code, sku.chinese_name as sku_name, soi.quantity, (poi.quantity - IFNULL(poi.shipped_quantity, 0) - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(other_soi.quantity) FROM wms_shipping_order_item other_soi INNER JOIN wms_shipping_order other_so ON other_so.id = other_soi.shipping_order_id WHERE other_soi.purchase_order_item_id = soi.purchase_order_item_id AND other_so.deleted = 0 AND other_so.shipping_status = 'PENDING' AND other_so.id <> #{shippingOrderId} ), 0)) AS available_quantity, soi.received_quantity, soi.remark FROM wms_shipping_order_item soi LEFT JOIN wms_purchase_order po ON soi.purchase_order_id = po.id LEFT JOIN wms_purchase_order_item poi ON soi.purchase_order_item_id = poi.id LEFT JOIN sku ON soi.sku_code = sku.sku_code WHERE soi.shipping_order_id = #{shippingOrderId} ORDER BY soi.id ASC

update.foreach: UPDATE wms_shipping_order_item SET received_quantity = received_quantity + #{param.quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{param.shippingOrderItemId}

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(received_quantity), 0) AS totalReceivedQuantity FROM wms_shipping_order_item WHERE shipping_order_id = #{shippingOrderId}
